raw_segments.text: Few minutes later, Karan came along and found Ingmar sitting on the doorstep with a wound
in his neck, and inside she discovered Helgham, who by that time had got to his feet again
and was now leaning against the wall, axe in hand and his face covered with blood.
Karan had not seen the fleeing men.
She supposed that Ingmar was the one who had attacked Helgham and wounded him.
She was so horrified that her knees shook.
It can't be possible that anyone in our family is a murderer.
Then she recalled the story of her mother.
That accounts for it, she muttered, and hurried past Ingmar over to Helgham.
